blocks.caption: Figure 30.5-2 shows main functional blocks in GP-SPI, including:

c.v: Master FSM: all the features, supported in
master mode, are controlled by this state machine together with register configuration.
The data transferred in CPU-controlled mode is prepared in this buffer.
Timing Module: capture data on FSPI/SPI3 bus.
spi_mst/slv_din/dout_ctrl: convert the TX/RX data into bytes.
buf_tx_afifo: store the data to send.
clk_spi_mst: this clock is the module clock of GP-SPI and derived from
It is used in GP-SPI master mode, to generate SPI_CLK signal for data transfer and for slaves.
SPI_CLK Generator: generate SPI_CLK by dividing clk_spi_mst.
SPI_CLK_out Mode Control: output the SPI_CLK signal for data transfer and for slaves.
SPI_CLK_in Mode Control: capture the SPI_CLK signal from SPI master when GP-SPI works as a slave.
